About the job

Practicante de Marketing

Ubicación: Remoto / Puebla, México

Tipo de puesto: Prácticas profesionales

Idioma: Español

Modalidad: Remota o mixta

Apoyo económico mensual:150 a 250 EUR




Sobre ROSA

ROSA es una startup internacional de tecnología deportiva enfocada en pádel. Desarrollamos productos que combinan hardware, software, video y analítica de rendimiento para llevar una experiencia profesional a más canchas. Nuestra operación y visión de mercado están vinculadas tanto a México como a Alemania.

Esta práctica ofrece algo más que apoyo en tareas de marketing: es una oportunidad para conocer desde dentro cómo se construye y opera una startup internacional, colaborando en proyectos reales con impacto en producto, marca y crecimiento.

Sobre la posición

Buscamos un/a Practicante de Marketing para apoyar iniciativas de marca, contenido y crecimiento en ROSA. Es una posición ideal para alguien con interés en marketing, tecnología, deporte y startups, que quiera ganar experiencia práctica en un entorno dinámico y multidisciplinario.

Excelente redacción y ortografía en español

En ROSA no solo aprenderás marketing. También podrás ver cómo se construye una startup desde dentro: cómo se validan ideas, cómo se priorizan proyectos, cómo se conectan producto, negocio y marca, y cómo se trabaja entre distintos mercados.

About the job

GoPancham | Full-time | Daily overlap with US/Canada hours

Compensation: $23,500 – $45,000/yr USD (base + retention bonus + commission)

This isn’t a “check in and relay updates” role. It’s strategic growth, and your clients stay because of you.




About GoPancham

GoPancham is an Inc. 5000 agency helping fitness businesses grow through paid social on Meta, Google & YouTube. 200+ active clients, 700+ businesses served, 50+ team members worldwide, 7+ years running.




About the Role

This is not a media buying role. We have a dedicated team for that. You’ll own a portfolio of fitness business owners as their primary strategic partner. A separate team of media buyers, creative strategists, and designers handles all campaign execution. Your job is the client relationship, not the ad account: turning their data into direction and making every client feel like they have a real growth partner in their corner.




What You’ll Do

You’ll own your book of clients, with retention as a direct reflection of how you manage it. You’ll run structured strategy calls back-to-back without losing context between them, and turn Meta and Google performance data into clear direction clients trust without needing to run the campaigns yourself. You’ll build 6–12 month growth strategies rather than weekly check-ins, spot retention risk before it becomes a cancellation, and collaborate daily with media buyers, creatives, and designers without being one of them.




Who This Role Is NOT For

This isn’t for someone whose experience is running ad accounts or campaigns without owning the client relationship. That’s our media buying team’s job, not this one. It’s also not for candidates coming from ticket-based customer support with no strategic marketing input, anyone who waits for clients to raise concerns before acting, or anyone who needs step-by-step instructions for every situation. If “checking in” is your idea of account management, this isn’t the role.




What We’re Looking For
Portfolio ownership: 3+ years as the named point of contact for a real client portfolio, not executing marketing tasks or tickets behind the scenes
Marketing knowledge: Deep enough to lead a strategic client conversation with confidence, even without hands-on campaign execution
Proven track record: Real numbers on accounts managed and retention achieved
Time management: Strong ability to run back-to-back client calls without losing the thread
Communication: A confident communicator clients genuinely trust
Availability: Full-time, with real daily overlap on US/Canada hours

Nice to have: Agency background (multi-client portfolios over in-house), CRM familiarity (GoHighLevel/HubSpot), fitness industry experience.




What Success Looks Like
Retention: Clients stay because they trust the direction you’re giving them
Portfolio health: A full book managed without dropping context or losing ground on any account
Strategic trust: Clients treat you as their growth partner, not a status-update relay




How to Apply

Apply by filling out the form here:

https://hiring.kickstartmyfitnessjourney.com/client-strategy-manager-mx

When you apply, be ready to talk numbers: how many accounts you’ve owned and what your retention rate looked like. No script, no fluff. Just your track record.

description:
About the job

Are you a Georgian language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple tools into powerful engines of understanding, communication, and learning. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and culturally aware language experiences across education, technology, and global communication. That training data begins with you—your linguistic expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for a highly skilled Georgian Language Specialist to help evaluate, annotate, and refine AI-generated content. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI systems, assessing the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of Georgian text, while providing expert feedback to improve model performance.

On a typical day, you will review Georgian text outputs, correct linguistic errors, ensure proper grammar and idiomatic usage, and contribute to the development of evaluation guidelines. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance data quality and model understanding of Georgian language and culture.

Fluency in Georgian and English is required. A background in linguistics, translation, language education, or related fields is preferred. Strong attention to detail, cultural awareness, and excellent communication skills are essential. Prior experience with AI training, localization, or content evaluation is a plus but not required.

Ready to bring your Georgian language expertise to the frontier of AI development? Apply today and help shape the technology that will bridge communication across cultures.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Empresa confidencial del sector belleza busca un(a) Coordinador(a) de Innovación de Producto para un puesto presencial en Monterrey, Nuevo León.




Descripción de la vacante:

Buscamos a una persona apasionada por la industria del maquillaje para liderar el desarrollo de nuevos productos y proyectos. Será responsable de identificar oportunidades de innovación, investigar tendencias globales, asistir a ferias internacionales y gestionar la relación con proveedores estratégicos para llevar nuevas ideas desde su conceptualización hasta su lanzamiento.

Este rol fungirá como enlace entre las tendencias del mercado y el desarrollo de producto, presentando propuestas y oportunidades de negocio a la dirección. Buscamos a alguien con visión estratégica, criterio estético, capacidad de negociación y un profundo conocimiento de la industria de la belleza, que disfrute mantenerse al día con las últimas tendencias y transformarlas en productos relevantes para el mercado.




Responsabilidades:

Asistir a ferias internacionales de la industria de la belleza (aproximadamente cinco al año) para identificar nuevos proveedores, tendencias, innovaciones y oportunidades de desarrollo de producto.
Gestionar la relación y comunicación continua con proveedores nacionales e internacionales para desarrollar nuevos productos, extensiones de línea, variaciones de color, kits y desarrollos exclusivos.
Investigar, contactar y evaluar nuevos proveedores que fortalezcan y diversifiquen el portafolio de productos.
Desarrollar presentaciones ejecutivas con propuestas de nuevos productos, colecciones, categorías y estrategias de lanzamiento para la dirección.
Administrar el ciclo de vida del portafolio, identificando oportunidades para actualizar productos, ampliar gamas de tonos, optimizar líneas existentes y descontinuar productos de baja rotación o con menor relevancia en el mercado.
Monitorear de forma constante las tendencias globales en color, texturas, acabados, ingredientes, formatos y categorías dentro de la industria del maquillaje, convirtiéndolas en propuestas estratégicas para la empresa.
Diseñar propuestas de colecciones, kits y lanzamientos alineados con las tendencias del mercado y las necesidades del consumidor.
Dar seguimiento al proceso de desarrollo de producto con proveedores, incluyendo muestras, cotizaciones, negociaciones, cronogramas, aprobaciones y coordinación hasta su lanzamiento.
Colaborar con las áreas internas involucradas para asegurar que cada lanzamiento cumpla con los objetivos comerciales, de calidad y de posicionamiento de la marca.




Perfil Ideal:

Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Negocios Internacionales, Diseño, Administración o carrera afín.
Experiencia en desarrollo de producto, compras, sourcing, merchandising o posiciones similares dentro de la industria de belleza, cosméticos o cuidado personal.
Conocimiento sólido de la industria del maquillaje, incluyendo productos, tendencias, marcas, formatos y comportamiento del consumidor.
Inglés avanzado, indispensable para la comunicación y negociación con proveedores internacionales.
Capacidad para desarrollar presentaciones ejecutivas claras, estructuradas y orientadas a la toma de decisiones.
Habilidades de organización, planeación y seguimiento, con capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos de manera simultánea.
Perfil analítico con iniciativa, atención al detalle y enfoque en resultados.
Disponibilidad para viajar a ferias nacionales e internacionales aproximadamente cinco veces al año.
Pasión por la innovación, las tendencias y el desarrollo de productos de belleza. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute descubrir lo que viene antes que nadie y transformarlo en oportunidades de negocio.

Experiencia asistiendo a ferias internacionales o trabajando con proveedores extranjeros será considerada un plus.




Lo que ofrecemos:

Oportunidad de liderar el desarrollo e innovación de productos con impacto directo en el portafolio y la estrategia de la empresa.
Participación en ferias nacionales e internacionales de la industria de la belleza para mantenerse al día con las últimas tendencias e innovaciones.
Entorno de trabajo dinámico, colaborativo y de alto crecimiento, con autonomía para proponer, desarrollar e impulsar nuevas ideas.
Exposición directa a la dirección de la empresa, participando activamente en la toma de decisiones estratégicas desde el inicio.
Desarrollo profesional en una empresa en crecimiento, con la posibilidad de dejar una huella tangible en la evolución del portafolio de productos.
Prestaciones de Ley
Salario Competitivo

title: Director Growth / Marketing
description:
About the job

Diseñar y liderar la estrategia integral de growth y marketing (adquisición, activación, retención y marca) alineada a

los objetivos comerciales de la empresa.

• Dirigir la generación y calificación de leads a través de canales digitales de performance (SEM, paid social, SEO,

programática) y tradicionales.

• Construir y proteger el posicionamiento de marca de GDC Desarrollos mediante estrategias de branding, contenido y

comunicación.

• Diseñar y optimizar el embudo de conversión en conjunto con el equipo comercial, incluyendo CRM, nutrición de

leads CALIFICADOS y seguimiento hasta el cierre de venta.

• Definir, monitorear y reportar KPIs de adquisición y crecimiento (CAC, LTV, tasa de conversión, ROAS, velocidad de

venta).

• Administrar el presupuesto de marketing y growth, asegurando eficiencia y retorno sobre la inversión en cada canal.

• Liderar al equipo interno de marketing y coordinar agencias, proveedores y consultores externos.

• Diseñar la estrategia de go-to-market para el lanzamiento de nuevos desarrollos y fases de proyectos existentes.

• Colaborar estrechamente con las direcciones Comercial, de Producto/Desarrollo y General para asegurar consistencia

entre oferta, mensaje y mercado.

• Identificar e incorporar herramientas y tendencias de martech/proptech que mejoren la eficiencia y efectividad del área.

Perfil y requisitos

• Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Negocios o carrera afín; deseable posgrado en Marketing, Growth o

Negocios.

• 7 a 10 años de experiencia en marketing y/o growth, idealmente en real estate, retail, consumo o industrias de ticket

alto y ciclo de venta largo.

• Experiencia previa liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y gestionando presupuestos significativos de marketing.

• Dominio de herramientas de performance marketing digital (Google Ads, Meta Ads, analítica web) y de

CRM/marketing automation.

• Fuerte orientación analítica: capacidad de tomar decisiones basadas en datos y de traducir métricas en acciones

concretas.

• Habilidades sólidas de liderazgo, comunicación y gestión de stakeholders internos y externos.• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (deseable).

• Se valora especialmente experiencia previa en PropTech o portales/plataformas inmobiliarias (ej. marketplaces,

brokers digitales, desarrolladoras), con resultados demostrables en crecimiento de ventas y participación de

mercado.

• Track record cuantificable y verificable: crecimiento de ventas o leads año contra año, costo por lead (CPL)

competitivo para la categoría, ROAS sostenido y reducción de costo de adquisición (CPA) en campañas gestionadas.

• Experiencia liderando equipos de tamaño relevante (12+ personas) entre marketing, growth, performance y contenido.

• Implementación y gestión de plataformas de CRM/Marketing Automation de nivel empresarial (p. ej. Salesforce,

Marketing Cloud, HubSpot).

• Experiencia liderando lanzamientos Go-to-Market (GTM) de productos, marcas o nuevas líneas de negocio.

Competencias clave

• Visión estratégica combinada con capacidad de ejecución.

• Liderazgo de equipos y gestión de proveedores/agencias.

• Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados.

• Creatividad aplicada a la construcción de marca.

• Adaptabilidad para operar en un entorno de múltiples proyectos y plazos simultáneos.

Indicadores de éxito (KPIs)

• Costo de adquisición de cliente (CAC) y valor de vida del cliente (LTV).

• Volumen y calidad de leads calificados generados.

• Tasa de conversión de lead a venta.

• Retorno sobre inversión publicitaria (ROAS) por campaña y canal.

• Velocidad de venta de unidades por desarrollo.

• Indicadores de posicionamiento y percepción de marca.

Mejores prácticas y expectativas del rol (benchmark de mercado)

Resultados esperados para el puesto:

• Resultados de negocio cuantificables y auditables: crecimiento de ventas de doble dígito año contra año, incrementos

sostenidos en participación de tráfico/categoría, y mejoras medibles en conversión (no solo entregables o actividad).

• Volumen de generación de demanda relevante para el tamaño del negocio (referencia de mercado: +5,000 leads

calificados/mes en operaciones de escala similar) con costo por lead controlado y en mejora continua.

• Eficiencia publicitaria demostrada: capacidad de reducir CPA/CPL de forma sostenida (referencia de mercado:

reducciones de 40-60% en proyectos de optimización de performance) y mantener ROAS positivo por canal.

• Experiencia liderando la adopción de CRM/MarTech como palanca de crecimiento (no solo como herramienta

operativa), incluyendo automatización de nutrición de leads e integración con el equipo comercial.

• Capacidad de operar tanto la estrategia (marca, GTM, posicionamiento) como la ejecución táctica (paid media, CRM,

analítica), dado que en este nivel de organización el rol suele combinar ambas dimensiones.

• Claridad y alineación temprana sobre modalidad de trabajo y esquema de compensación: perfiles senior de este

mercado suelen buscar esquemas remotos o hero-flexibles y compensaciones desde 10,000-12,000 USD/mes en roles

regionales full-time; es recomendable comunicar desde la primera entrevista que el puesto opera en modalidad

presencial para evitar desalineación y desgaste del proceso de reclutamiento.

• Preferencia por candidatos con paso reciente por negocios de ticket alto y ciclo de venta largo (real estate, automotriz,

servicios financieros) sobre perfiles puramente transaccionales/e-commerce de bajo ticket.

title: Manager de Medios On y Off
description:
About the job

En Wivboost seguimos creciendo y buscamos Manager en Medios On y Off.

El Manager debe liderar la estrategia, planeación, implementación y optimización de campañas de medios ON y OFF, asegurando que la inversión de los clientes sea eficiente y esté alineada con sus objetivos de negocio, marketing y comunicación.




REQUISITOS:

Licenciatura en Marketing, Publicidad, Comunicación, Administración o carrera afín.

Experiencia: idealmente 5 años en medios, con al menos 2 años coordinando equipos, cuentas o proyectos relevantes. Preferentemente experiencia previa en agencia de medios, publicidad o marketing.

Ingles:Intermedio




CONOCIMIENTOS TECNICOS:

planeación estratégica de medios ON/OFF

Google Ads, Meta Ads y plataformas digitales; programmatic

Herramientas de medición y analytics

Compra y negociación de medios offline

Elaboración de planes de inversión 

Análisis de audiencias y resultados

Excel/Google Sheets avanzado y herramientas de reporting.




RESPONSABILIDADES:

* Diseñar estrategias integrales de medios ON & OFF de acuerdo con los objetivos, audiencias, presupuesto y KPIs de cada cliente.

* Desarrollar y supervisar planes de medios, definiendo media mix, distribución de inversión, temporalidad, alcance y frecuencia.

* Liderar la estrategia de medios digitales: Paid Social, Paid Search, Display, Programmatic, Video, YouTube y otras plataformas digitales.

* Gestionar medios tradicionales: TV, radio, OOH/DOOH, prensa, revistas y otros formatos offline.

* Coordinar negociaciones con medios, publishers, centrales, proveedores y socios estratégicos.

* Supervisar presupuestos de medios, control de inversión, órdenes de compra, conciliaciones y cumplimiento del plan.

* Dar seguimiento al desempeño de las campañas y realizar optimizaciones basadas en resultados.

* Analizar KPIs como CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, CPL, ROAS, alcance, frecuencia, impresiones y conversiones, según el objetivo de cada campaña.

* Elaborar y presentar reportes, análisis de resultados y recomendaciones estratégicas a clientes.

* Trabajar en conjunto con las áreas de Estrategia, Planning, Cuentas, Creatividad, Performance y Data/Analytics.

* Liderar y desarrollar al equipo de medios, estableciendo prioridades, cargas de trabajo y estándares de calidad.

* Mantenerse actualizado sobre tendencias, plataformas, formatos, audiencias y oportunidades de innovación en medios.

* Participar en pitches y propuestas comerciales cuando sea necesario.




Competencias clave: pensamiento estratégico y analítico, liderazgo, negociación, organización, orientación a resultados, manejo de clientes, comunicación ejecutiva, capacidad para trabajar con múltiples cuentas y presupuestos simultáneamente.

description:
About the job

Job Purpose

A personality that shines, the ability to adapt to any situation and make people feel at ease. These are a few of the qualities we’re looking for in our cabin crew.

As the face of Emirates, you’ll be the person customers turn to for help and direction when they fly with us, so you need to be friendly, observant and able to provide the right support.

Being a member of the cabin crew is so much more than a service role - safety is our highest priority. You’ll need to lead confidently and take control when it comes to managing aircraft services, security, and safety procedures. This comes from the world-class learning experience our crew receive at our state-of-the-art facility in Dubai.




Qualifications & Experience




Here are some other things we look for in our cabin crew:

You’ve had more than a year’s experience in hospitality/customer service
You have a positive attitude and the natural ability to provide excellent service in a team environment, dealing with people from many cultures
Your minimum qualification is high school graduate (Grade 12)
You need to be fluent in written and spoken English
You’re at least 160cm tall and can reach 212 cm while standing on tiptoes, to enable you to reach emergency equipment on all aircraft types
No visible tattoos while you’re in Emirates cabin crew uniform (without covering them with bandages or cosmetics)
As Emirates cabin crew, you’ll be based in Dubai and will need to meet the UAE's employment visa requirements




Aside from the requirements of the role, you should be determined to always perform to the highest standards, focus on being solution oriented, and be able to manage a demanding work schedule. You should have the ability to deliver an authentic experience to our customers. You’ll be culturally aware and reflect the Emirates personality - professional, empathetic, progressive, visionary and cosmopolitan.




Salary & Benefits




Your pay is made up of three components:

a fixed basic salary,
an hourly pay for operated flights and
an overseas meal allowance.




Basic salary = AED 4,980 / month,

Flying Pay = AED 69.60 / hour based on avg. 80-100 hours / month,

Average Total Pay = AED 11,244 / month (~USD 3,100, EUR 2,600 or GBP 2,280)

* These are approximate numbers for Grade II (Economy Class).




Meal allowances for night stops are credited to the salary in arrears the following month.

Hotel accommodation as well as transport to and from the airport is provided by the company.




Join Emirates as cabin crew and enjoy a competitive, tax-free salary, flying pay, profit share, and concessional travel. Benefit from comprehensive relocation support to help you settle in Dubai, along with free accommodation and transportation. You will also receive excellent medical, life, and dental insurance, and more. Additionally, your friends and family can enjoy discounted flights, creating lasting memories together.

About the job

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. description:
About the job

Description

Everyone on our team has a meaningful impact on product features, new directions in music streaming, and customer engagement. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented and passionate UX Designer to play a vital role in shaping the products and services for Amazon Music. Our ideal candidate has the ability to delight customers with their user-centered product design work, by solving customers’ problems and tapping into customers’ love and passion for music.

Key job responsibilities


 Lead UX design for projects across platforms that touch numerous aspects of the Amazon Music experience.
 Run the full experience design process (i.e., discovery, research, concept development, wireframes, high-fidelity mocks) with a particular focus on customer mindsets, complex interaction solutions, user flows, and end-to-end customer journeys.

 Quickly iterate on multiple design explorations to arrive at simple, but robust solutions, accounting for complex requirements.
 Validate designs through research and testing.
 Design for current experiences while also envisioning and creating new experiences for future features.
 Stay current on emerging UX and digital behavior trends, music and design innovations, and broader technological shifts, as well as identify opportunities to incorporate best current thinking into product designs.
 Collaborate on and present work to a range of stakeholders – executives, engineers, product managers, business leaders, researchers, other UX and visual designers.


A day in the life

As UX Designer on this team, you will help define, build, and deliver customer-facing experiences and tools, as well as delightful fan experiences from discovery and research to concept development, wireframes, and high-fidelity cross-platform mocks. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization, working from high-level requirements to define product design flows, interactions, and content strategies. You will incorporate best current thinking into product designs, while also envisioning and creating new experiences for future features. To be successful you must be collaborative, customer-focused problem solver with clear design chops, an excitement for applying data, and an ability to communicate your ideas effectively. Being a big music fan is a plus.

About The Team

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners across different tiers of service. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Basic Qualifications


 2+ years of design experience
 Have an available online portfolio
 Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar
 Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in a highly agile environment
 Experience working in a collaborative multi-disciplinary team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs
 Experience in usability testing

Nuestra plataforma cuenta con ventajas competitivas únicas:

Cada evaluación crediticia incorpora nuevas empresas al ecosistema.
Cada empresa evaluada aporta nuevas referencias comerciales.
Cada interacción genera oportunidades para adquirir usuarios y aumentar la adopción del producto.

Tu misión será potenciar estos mecanismos naturales de crecimiento y construir un motor escalable de adquisición, activación y conversión.




🎯 Principales Responsabilidades




1. Estrategia y Ejecución de Growth

Diseñar e implementar iniciativas de crecimiento enfocadas en adquisición, activación, engagement y conversión de usuarios.
Identificar oportunidades de optimización en los embudos de conversión y desarrollar soluciones basadas en datos.
Construir sistemas de crecimiento escalables aprovechando los activos de datos y los efectos de red existentes.
Diseñar y ejecutar experimentos continuos para validar nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.
Trabajar junto al equipo de liderazgo para definir e implementar iniciativas estratégicas de alto impacto.




2. Product-Led Growth (PLG)

Colaborar con los equipos de Producto y Liderazgo para mejorar el onboarding y la adopción del producto.
Diseñar estrategias que permitan a los usuarios experimentar valor en el menor tiempo posible.
Optimizar el recorrido de conversión de usuarios gratuitos a clientes de pago.
Identificar oportunidades para aumentar el uso recurrente y la retención del producto.
Impulsar iniciativas de crecimiento basadas en la experiencia del usuario.




3. Lifecycle Marketing y Automatización

Diseñar y optimizar estrategias de marketing a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del cliente.
Crear flujos automatizados de onboarding, nutrición, reactivación y fidelización.
Implementar estrategias de segmentación para aumentar la interacción y las conversiones.
Gestionar plataformas de automatización y CRM para ofrecer experiencias personalizadas.




4. Analítica y Experimentación

Monitorear y analizar métricas clave de crecimiento en todo el funnel.
Diseñar y ejecutar pruebas A/B y experimentos de optimización.
Crear dashboards y modelos de medición para evaluar el desempeño de las iniciativas de Growth.
Generar insights accionables basados en datos.
Promover una cultura de mejora continua y toma de decisiones basada en evidencia.




5. Trabajo Transversal

Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Ventas, Customer Success, Data y Leadership.
Alinear las iniciativas de Growth con los objetivos estratégicos del negocio.
Compartir aprendizajes e insights que contribuyan a mejorar la experiencia del cliente y el producto.
Fomentar una cultura de experimentación e innovación.




📊 ¿Cómo se medirá el éxito en este rol?




Durante el primer año, el éxito estará asociado a:

Incrementar la adquisición de usuarios aprovechando las bases de datos y mecanismos de crecimiento existentes.
Mejorar las tasas de onboarding y activación.
Optimizar los recorridos del cliente y las automatizaciones.
Incrementar la adopción del producto y la conversión a clientes de pago.
Construir un motor de crecimiento repetible y escalable.
Generar aprendizajes y experimentos que impacten positivamente los indicadores del negocio.




🧬 Requisitos




Indispensables




Más de 5 años de experiencia en Growth, Growth Marketing, Product Growth, Lifecycle Marketing o posiciones similares.
Experiencia comprobada escalando adquisición, activación y conversión de usuarios en empresas SaaS, FinTech, tecnología B2B o plataformas digitales.
Experiencia sólida con herramientas de automatización y CRM como HubSpot, Brevo, Customer.io, Mailchimp o similares.
Profundo conocimiento de customer journeys, lifecycle marketing y optimización de funnels.
Experiencia diseñando y ejecutando estrategias de pruebas A/B.
Fuertes habilidades analíticas y orientación a la toma de decisiones basada en datos.
Perfil autónomo, proactivo y con alta capacidad de ejecución.
Excelente capacidad para trabajar de forma transversal con diferentes equipos.




Deseable




Experiencia en FinTech, SaaS, CreditTech, PaymentTech o plataformas de suscripción.
Experiencia implementando estrategias de Product-Led Growth (PLG).
Experiencia trabajando con efectos de red, programas de referidos, ciclos virales o modelos tipo marketplace.
Manejo de herramientas analíticas como Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, Looker Studio o similares.
Experiencia en startups o empresas de alto crecimiento.




🔎 Perfil Ideal




Buscamos una persona que:

Piense en sistemas y crecimiento escalable.
Sea altamente analítica y orientada a resultados.
Combine visión estratégica con capacidad de ejecución.
Disfrute experimentar, medir y optimizar continuamente.
Tome decisiones basadas en datos y no en supuestos.
Se adapte bien a entornos dinámicos y de rápido crecimiento.
Sea colaborativa, curiosa y con fuerte sentido de ownership.
Entienda que el mejor crecimiento sostenible proviene de generar valor para el usuario.




🚀 ¿Por qué unirte?




Ser protagonista en la evolución de una plataforma tecnológica con un modelo de crecimiento único.
Trabajar sobre un producto con efectos de red integrados y un enorme potencial de escalabilidad.
Colaborar directamente con el equipo de liderazgo y participar en decisiones estratégicas.
Tener autonomía para proponer, experimentar e implementar nuevas iniciativas de crecimiento.
Generar un impacto tangible y medible en el crecimiento del negocio.
Formar parte de un entorno innovador, dinámico y orientado a resultados.




⚡ El impacto que generarás




En tus primeros 12 meses contribuirás a:

Acelerar la adquisición y activación de usuarios.
Mejorar la experiencia de onboarding y el engagement del cliente.
Incrementar la adopción y conversión del producto.
Construir mecanismos de crecimiento escalables y sostenibles.
Transformar los datos, la experimentación y la experiencia del usuario en ventajas competitivas de largo plazo.

description:
About the job

Digital Marketing Manager (Shopify eCommerce Growth)




Remote (LATAM) | Full-Time | MST




Overview

We're looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager with deep Shopify eCommerce expertise to own and scale our digital growth strategy.




This is not a traditional digital marketing role. Your primary focus will be maximizing the Shopify ecosystem to drive revenue, optimize customer acquisition, improve conversion rates, and identify new growth opportunities.




You'll serve as the company's Shopify expert, bringing strategic ideas, implementing scalable solutions, and continuously optimizing the business for growth.




Key Responsibilities

Own and execute the Shopify eCommerce growth strategy.
Optimize the Shopify ecosystem, including Sales Channels, Search & Discovery, Shopify Collective, apps, and integrations.
Identify new revenue opportunities across channels, partnerships, and marketplaces.
Improve customer acquisition, conversion rates, and overall store performance.
Develop lifecycle marketing initiatives across Email and SMS.
Analyze KPIs, forecast growth opportunities, and optimize marketing ROI.
Recommend and implement new Shopify tools, features, and best practices.
Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to execute growth initiatives.




Success in this Role: Drive measurable revenue growth by maximizing the Shopify ecosystem and continuously identifying new opportunities to scale the business.




Requirements

5+ years of Digital Marketing or eCommerce Marketing experience.
Proven success growing Shopify-based eCommerce businesses.
Deep understanding of the Shopify ecosystem, including Sales Channels, Search & Discovery, Shopify Collective, apps, and integrations.
Strong background in performance marketing, customer acquisition, and eCommerce growth.
Experience improving conversion rates and online sales performance.
Analytical mindset with a strong focus on data and ROI.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take ownership.




What We're Looking For (Mindset)

Growth-oriented with a strong focus on business impact.
Naturally curious and always looking for new opportunities to increase revenue.
Data-driven and comfortable making decisions based on performance metrics.
Proactive, resourceful, and highly accountable.
Comfortable taking ownership and turning ideas into execution.




Nice to Have

Experience with DTC or consumer product brands.
CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) experience.
Experience with Shopify apps, automation tools, and third-party integrations.
Affiliate, partnership, or marketplace growth experience.
Experience collaborating with agencies or external vendors.




Why Join

Join a growing eCommerce business where you'll own the Shopify growth strategy and make a direct impact on revenue and long-term success.

About the job

CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

The Trade Marketing Manager LATAM is responsible for defining the regional Trade Marketing strategy and

governance across Mexico, Export, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, and Peru. Reporting to the Trade Marketing Director,

this role leads the Visual Strategy, Merchandising Governance, Trade Marketing Funds (TMF), and eCommerce

and B&M Catalog Excellence.

The position is accountable for the strategic planning, governance, financial management, and continuous

improvement of Trade Marketing investments while ensuring alignment across Brand Marketing, Sales, Finance,

Procurement, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and external partners. The role establishes regional standards, drives

operational excellence, manages strategic supplier relationships, and ensures compliance with Mattel's financial,

legal, and procurement policies.

Through data-driven decision making and cross-functional leadership, the Trade Marketing Manager enables

consistent execution across LATAM markets while maximizing investment effectiveness, strengthening retail

visibility, and supporting commercial growth.

What You’ll Do


Define and lead the LATAM Trade Marketing strategy, aligning annual commercial calendars, campaign priorities, visual strategies, and seasonal initiatives with Brand Marketing and commercial objectives across all markets. 
Own the governance of the regional Trade Marketing budget (TMF), leading Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Forecast cycles, budget allocation, financial reporting, monthly closings, and investment optimization across LATAM.
Lead the regional merchandising governance model, including agency sourcing, commercial negotiations, supplier performance management, service standards, benchmarking, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with Mattel's procurement, financial, and legal policies, overseeing Purchase Orders, contracts, supplier governance, audits, NDAs, FCPA requirements, and corporate controls.
Lead the regional eCommerce and B&M Catalog Excellence strategy, governing product cataloging, digital content quality, launch readiness, digital shelf performance, and strategic initiatives across key online retailers. Establish regional operating standards and governance, driving process standardization, KPI definition, reporting frameworks, and best practice implementation across LATAM markets.
Partner with cross-functional teams, including Brand Marketing, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and external partners to ensure alignment of Trade Marketing priorities and regional initiatives.
 Develop business insights and executive reporting, leveraging financial, commercial, and operational analytics to support strategic decision-making and maximize investment effectiveness.
Lead strategic regional projects and business transformation initiatives, driving operational efficiencies, capability development, digital transformation, and continuous improvement across the Trade Marketing organization.
 Lead, coach, and develop the regional Trade Marketing team, fostering a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, talent development, and execution excellence.


Who We’re Looking For


Bachelor's Degree Business Administration or International Business or Marketing
7-8 years experience in trade marketing, shopper marketing, commercial finance, or related areas in FMCG,retail, or eCommerce, preferably with regional scope.
Proven experience managing budgets, agencies, eCommerce cataloging, and regional coordination.
Languages Native Spanish and advanced English (C1–C2).
Channel knowledge Modern trade and eCommerce in LATAM, including retailers such as Walmart, Amazon,Chedraui, Falabella, Ripley, Éxito, Supermercados Peruanos, and Ri Happy.
Tools Coupa, Malibu, Salsify, Oracle, Amazon Vendor Central, Mercado Libre Seller Center, Tableau, Sales Kit, PIM, Sales Force.
Core competencies Negotiation, Leadership, Data analysis, Proactivity, Assertive communication, Stress and frustration tolerance, Strategic thinking and commercial
Ability to work under pressure
Strong compliance with internal procurement policies and corporate controls
Financial knowledge Basic understanding of P&L statements and financial implications of trade marketing Investments.
Certifications in data analysis, eCommerce, or digital marketing (Google Ads/Analytics, Amazon Advertising,
Tableau). PMP or project management methodologies (preferred).


How We Work

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors


We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results. 


Who We Are

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

description:
About the job

About the Company:

Wayfinder Agency is the #1 digital marketing agency for tabletop game companies, a fully remote team of marketers, media buyers, and creatives who help incredible games reach players around the world. Our campaigns have generated millions in Kickstarter pledges and eCommerce revenue for brands like Ravensburger, Roll20, Paizo, and Pandasaurus. We’re not your typical agency: we move fast, think creatively, and care deeply about performance. We operate with a lean, collaborative culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership, and if you love strategy, data, and working with passionate creative teams, you’ll fit right in. 




About the Role:

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Designer & Team Lead who will personally produce high-performing static and motion ads for paid digital campaigns every week, while also mentoring and developing a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers. This role is both a working creative seat and a leadership seat: you’ll build the templates, best practices, and workflows the team runs on, stay close to real performance data, and help define how creative gets made at a growing agency. A genuine passion for tabletop games and gaming culture is a major plus.




This role is a Full-Time remote position.




We are looking for a Senior Designer & Team Lead specifically with these requirements:

Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.




Nice to Haves:

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Personally design and produce static and simple motion ad-creative for paid social and digital platforms, working from account manager briefs and client-provided assets (our account managers own both the brief and the ad copy, so you can focus entirely on visual craft and execution).
Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.
Develop and document creative best practices, design standards, templates, and workflows that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers: assign work, balance bandwidth, give constructive design feedback, and support each designer’s professional growth.
Review team deliverables for quality, brand alignment, and performance potential.
Collaborate closely with account management, media buying, and leadership to keep creative aligned with campaign goals and performance objectives.
Communicate proactively with leadership regarding project status, resourcing needs, risks, and opportunities.
Stay current on paid social creative best practices, platform requirements, and trends within gaming and tabletop communities.




Growth Opportunities/Perks:

Opportunity to grow and develop the creative team as the agency scales.
Fully remote work environment.
A chance to define how creative gets made at a growing agency.
Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.




You’re a Great Fit for This Role If…

 ✅ You know what high-performing paid social creative looks like and can produce it yourself.

 ✅ You care about measurable outcomes such as CTR, conversions, and ROAS-not just visual quality.

 ✅ You work quickly, stay organized, and can turn limited client-provided assets into effective ads.

 ✅ You enjoy mentoring designers, giving clear feedback, and helping a creative team improve.

 ✅ You communicate proactively and thrive in a fast-moving, remote agency environment.




Our hiring process is made up of four parts, so please be aware that you will need to dedicate time for a questionnaire, a video, and two 1-on-1 interviews.




Thank you for taking the time to consider this position. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Who We Are

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

A Day In The Life

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 consumer services accounts — home services, education, financial services, hospitality, insurance, or similar lead-gen-driven businesses. You will serve as the primary strategic partner for your clients on a day-to-day basis, owning the narrative around performance, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all marketing efforts ladder up to business objectives. A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact.

As an AAD, you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for Consumer Services clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to lead quality, conversion, and revenue — not just lead volume. Every client in this vertical has a sales team, and that sales team will have opinions about whether marketing is delivering. Your job is to make sure you already know the answer before they ask. You will work closely with client marketing and sales or operations contacts to define what a qualified lead actually looks like — and build that definition back into targeting, creative, and campaign strategy. This role requires comfort discussing CPL, lead-to-close rate, cost per acquisition, funnel conversion, and local market dynamics. You'll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track — leading client calls directly on larger accounts, while the PM leads on smaller ones — and will collaborate with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

About the job

Company Description

The Company 

At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.

What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimers live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. As a Business Development Manager at QIMA, your primary responsibilities will include:


Client Portfolio Management: Develop and manage your own client portfolio, typically consisting of companies involved in the import and export of consumer goods globally.

Proficiency in B2B sales with a minimum experience of 1 year. 
A solid command over the English language. 
Exceptional communication skills with a knack for building diverse stakeholder relationships. 
Self-motivated individual with the ability to manage schedules autonomously and to effectively delegate and guide internal teams. 
Proven track record in sales, with a talent for identifying and developing new business opportunities as well as managing a client portfolio. 
Remarkable negotiation skills, with an ability to effectively interact in various cultural scenarios. 


WHAT ARE YOUR SOFT SKILLS? 

We are ardently in search of a Business Development Manager who displays an insatiable desire for discovering new business opportunities and driving expansion, complemented by a passion-filled, energetic, and positively invigorating attitude.

The ideal candidate would embody an inherent sense of initiative and self-motivation, show an independent and innovative approach towards problem-solving, and possess the capability to adeptly manage and steer projects to reach their fullest potential. Ultimately, these key qualities will prove pivotal in our selection process. We welcome those ready and excited to make a significant impact.

WHAT WILL YOU GAIN FROM THE EXPERIENCE? 


Sales Expertise: You will gain valuable, hands-on B2B sales experience in a global market. 
Cultural Insight: Working across different cultures, you'll develop an understanding of international business etiquette and norms. 
Industry Knowledge: You will gain insights into the product testing, inspection, and audit industry as well as global trade issues. 
Leadership Skills: As you'll manage your own schedule and guide internal teams, you'll refine your leadership and management skills. 
Networking: Given the role's nature, you will have the opportunity to network extensively, building useful connections. 
Professional Growth: At QIMA, your sales and negotiation skills will be honed, contributing significantly to your career growth. 
Rewarding Experience: Your contributions as a Business Development Manager will directly impact QIMA, making the experience fulfilling and rewarding. 


Additional Information

Benefits 


Monthly NET base salary $18,000 MXN
Commissions The commission rate is 2% for sales to existing company clients and 3% for sales to newly attracted clients
Christmas bonus (proportional to the time worked during the year) 
Legal benefits

Because our differences make the difference, at QIMA we are proud to promote inclusive diversity and equal opportunities! Our policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

QIMA recognizes and recruits all of its talents.

Monks is seeking a Visual Quality Analyst (QA) to join our global quality team supporting one of the biggest clients in the world. You’ll play a key role in ensuring visual excellence across large-scale digital campaigns and assets produced by cross-functional creative and production teams.

This role requires an expert eye for design, deep knowledge of testing tools, and the ability to manage complex QA processes for high-volume, high-visibility creative output.Role

As a Visual QA, you’ll be responsible for defining and executing testing strategies to ensure the highest level of quality across digital assets — including banners, images, and video content. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and engineering teams to identify visual inconsistencies, usability issues, and brand deviations before final delivery.

You’ll take ownership of your projects end-to-end: from planning and testing to bug management and post-delivery verification. 

Responsibilities



Review and test a wide range of digital assets (banners, images, videos, and more) with exceptional precision and attention to detail.
Execute QA strategies and test plans for multiple concurrent projects, ensuring timely delivery and top-tier quality.Identify, document, and prioritize bugs using standardized tracking tools; triage issues based on severity and impact.
Collaborate with designers, producers, and developers to resolve visual and technical issues efficiently.
Review specifications, brand guidelines, and design documents to anticipate potential quality risks.
Maintain fluent use of content Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems for organizing, retrieving, and tracking digital content.
Troubleshoot issues within the DAM system and suggest process improvements.
Create and maintain comprehensive QA documentation, test plans, and visual validation checklists.
Support overall operational efficiency by suggesting process improvements in testing and bug management workflows.
Work hands-on with Photoshop, Adobe Premiere, Sketch, and other creative tools to validate and analyze visual deliverables accurately.



Requirements



3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Testing, preferably within creative production, digital advertising, or post-production environments.
Strong understanding of graphic design principles and familiarity with tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Media Info, Frame.io, Photoshop, Adobe Premiere, and Sketch.
Hands-on experience with QA methodologies, testing processes, and bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Trello, or similar).Advanced attention to visual detail, with the ability to identify subtle inconsistencies across formats and platforms.
Proven ability to create, execute, and manage QA test plans for large-scale or complex campaigns.
Strong collaboration skills; able to work cross-functionally with design, production, and technology teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish fluency is a plus.
Proficiency in documentation creation, workflow mapping, and delivering training to larger groups.Highly organized, proactive, and self-sufficient — capable of owning multiple QA tracks simultaneously.
Based in Mexico City, with availability to work from the office three days per week.Proficient in English communication.
